```yaml
name: Build Release

on:
  release:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build frontend assets
        run: npm run build

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.2'
          coverage: none

      - name: Install PHP production dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          dependency-versions: production
          composer-options: "--no-dev --optimize-autoloader --prefer-dist --no-interaction"

      - name: Create production zip
        run: |
          # Create a temporary directory for the build
          mkdir -p build/pressforward
          
          # Use rsync to copy files, excluding those in .distignore
          # We need to convert .distignore patterns to rsync exclude patterns
          # Common exclusions for WP plugins:
          # - .git, .github, .distignore, .editorconfig, .gitignore
          # - node_modules, vendor (dev parts), tests, docs, src (if compiled)
          # - package.json, package-lock.json, composer.json, composer.lock
          # - .env, .env.example
          
          # Since .distignore is mentioned, we assume it exists. 
          # However, rsync doesn't natively read .distignore. 
          # We will use a standard set of exclusions typical for this workflow 
          # or parse .distignore if it follows standard gitignore syntax.
          # For robustness in CI, we'll use explicit rsync excludes based on common WP plugin structure
          # and the description "dev dependencies, tests, source files, documentation, vendor test directories".
          
          rsync -a --exclude-from='.distignore' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.github' . build/pressforward/
          
          # Create the zip file
          cd build
          zip -r pressforward.zip pressforward/
          cd ..

      - name: Upload release asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./build/pressforward.zip
          asset_name: pressforward.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip
```
